name: Four Seasons Dubai at Jumeirah Beach
positioning: Beachfront resort on Jumeirah Beach in Dubai
best_for: Families who want a kids' club and separate pools

facts.text: Opened in November 2014 with 237 rooms and suites (188 guest rooms and 49 suites) on a 14-acre beachfront site.
Located on Jumeirah Beach Road in Jumeirah 2, Dubai, about 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport.
Spanish-Mediterranean architecture with Arabic accents; the lobby has an octagonal dome finished in gold leaf.
The resort has a 270-metre (886-foot) natural beach.
Dining: Mercury Rooftop (Mediterranean-Asian fusion), Sea Fu (modern seafood), Jou Jou Brasserie (Mediterranean), Sea Fu Bar, Shai Salon and Hendricks Bar.
Three pools: an outdoor Adult Pool, an outdoor Active Pool and an indoor spa pool.
The Pearl Spa has 10 treatment rooms, including a couple's suite, and a glass-canopied indoor pool.
Two hard tennis courts, and a fitness centre open 24 hours with a whirlpool, sauna and steam room.
Independent restaurants next door include Coya (Peruvian), Mimi Kakushi (Far Eastern), Nammos (Greek) and Nusr-Et (Turkish).

highlights.text: A 270-metre natural beach, with a watersports center on the 14-acre property.
Mercury Rooftop is an outdoor Mediterranean-Asian restaurant with 250 outdoor seats.
An outdoor Adult Pool is separate from the family-oriented Active Pool, so quiet and family time each get their own space.
Families get a free Kids For All Seasons activity center, babysitting, and mini treatments for children at the spa.
Rooms have 9.8-foot ceilings and marble floors, with either sea or city skyline views.

considerations.text: The resort is isolated on the beach with little to see on foot. Old Dubai and downtown Dubai are each about a 20-minute drive away.
Restaurants and bars are expensive, and breakfast is not always included in room rates. The standard published rate is room only.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing and that the popular location can be busy in peak seasons.
Per an Oyster review, restaurants and bars may close during Ramadan, and some rooms overlook construction sites. Both are worth asking the hotel about before booking.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily (the standard published rate is room only, with breakfast usually extra).
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers are combinable with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
